Body.Content:
Confirm demand on a stocked material estimate in Dataverse to create an item requirement in finance and operations. This connects material estimates to supply chain processes for procurement and proactive planning, rather than limiting them to materials already on hand.

In Dataverse, you can request packing-slip posting or cancellation, close the remaining quantity on the item requirement, and check processing results. Finance and operations processes the inventory movement and project cost, and material usage information returns to Dataverse.

An administrator or maker enables or configures the capability for users. This feature applies to the Project Operations connected with ERP deployment type.
